content_sections.heading: Annamalai University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Junior Research Fellow (JRF), 1 for Junior Project Fellow (JPF) and 1 for Field Worker.

content_sections.heading: Annamalai University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.E./ M.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE). Junior Project Fellow (JPF): MCA or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE). Field Worker: Three-year Diploma in Engineering

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Annamalai University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Annamalai University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Annamalai University Recruitment 2026 is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Annamalai University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Annamalai University has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Junior Project Fellow (JPF), and Field Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for these positions by sending their applications via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is ₹37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Field Worker position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Field Worker position must possess a Three-year Diploma in Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Annamalai University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Annamalai University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The positions advertised under Annamalai University Recruitment 2026 are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Annamalai University located?
faq.answer: Annamalai University is located in Annamalainagar, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 608002.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Annamalai University in Tamil Nadu. While the notification does not explicitly restrict applications by state, candidates should check the official notification for any specific eligibility criteria regarding domicile.
